Are you passionate about food safety, and do you have solid experience with quality management and HACCP? Dan Cake in Give is growing, and due to high demand, we are now looking for a quality coordinator to join our dynamic team. We produce everything from sliced cakes to cookies and are in the midst of an exciting development process. The factory expansion has just been completed.

About the Job

You'll have an independent and varied full-time position with broad exposure across the organization.

Your main responsibilities will be:

• Maintenance and Development of the Quality Management System and HACCP

• HACCP Team Participation and Internal Audit

• Risk assessment of raw materials, development of sampling plans, and physical sampling

• Participation in day-to-day operations by monitoring production and raw material receipts

• Contribute to the company’s transition toward more digitized documentation and to the further development of our traceability system

Your Profile

We expect you to have 5–7 years of experience in a similar role in the food industry (preferably with baking experience).

In addition, we place importance on the fact that you:

• Has experience with HACCP-based management systems (IFS and BRC)

• Communicates persuasively in Danish and English, both in writing and orally (German is a plus)

• Works in a structured and systematic manner and has a strong sense of order

• I am an experienced IT user and am open to trying new digital systems

• Is trustworthy, a good listener, and thrives in a team environment

We offer

An exciting and challenging job at a reputable company characterized by a fast-paced environment, a high level of commitment, and a strong sense of team spirit. The work atmosphere is positive and informal. Salary and pension benefits are determined based on qualifications. Flexibility regarding work hours may be available as needed.

Application

We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis and expect to complete the recruitment process in October 2026.

Please submit your application and resume as soon as possible.

Please note that we only accept applications through our website:

Please enter "Quality Coordinator" in the subject line.

**In this Staff Software Engineering role, you’ll be…

**

• Responsible for the full product development end-to-end.

• A technical lighthouse, defining architecture and coordinating with other engineers to move how we do engineering forward.

• Collaborating across Engineering, Product, and Design to shape the solution to the problem and oversee technical implementations from end to end.

• A leader and mentor without direct people management. Continuous learning and knowledge-sharing are in your DNA, as you challenge the status quo, iterate, and learn from mistakes to build creative business solutions.

**Who is the Marketplace Team?

**The Marketplace Team works on our critical strategic mission to build the best solutions by partnering with leading consultants in Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC).

Our partner platform, or marketplace as we call it, allows partners to use, build, and customise needed solutions for their clients.

Essentially, we contribute to our vision of becoming the leading GRC platform that helps organisations do the right thing to keep society safe, fair, and functional.

****Our tech stack:

• PHP with Laravel

• Angular 22

• TailwindCSS

• PostgreSQL

• Redis for caching

• Claude Code

• Serverless infrastructure on AWS

****What you’ll bring:

• Expert knowledge in at least one layer of our technical stack (we work with PHP and Angular), as well as general software architecture and system design.

• Demonstrated senior experience in a Software Engineering role, designing, building, and maintaining highly scalable systems in production, end-to-end.

• Experience in product development with a focus on quality and value delivery.

• The ability to define technical direction for systems clearly and lead actively in deep architectural and software design sessions.

• Good engineering practices for testing, deployment, & observability paired with the ability to communicate strategic trade-offs clearly, mentor senior colleagues, and increase impact across the organisation.

• The ability to raise the bar for engineering quality and performance through reference implementations and by defining ever-evolving code standards.

****We offer you:

• A starting salary of 79,000 DKK per month. As you grow within this role, your compensation can grow with you up to 89,000 DKK per month.

• Continuous development through a clear and transparent framework, so you always know what the next step looks like through bi-annual growth talks and regular check-ins.

• Thorough pre-boarding and onboarding to set you up for success.

• An office-first culture in a centrally located office near Kødbyen, along with visa support if needed.

• A culture of ownership, trust, and independence with the support you need.

• A strong team spirit where we celebrate wins and enjoy time together across offices.

• Our annual Global Summit, where the whole company connects over strategic achievements and projects.

****Our recruitment process:

• 
Send your application and upload relevant information.

• 
30-minute online interview with our Talent Acquisition team.

• 
30-minute online interview with the Hiring Manager.

• 
Completion of Personality Assessment & 1h Technical Assessment.

• 
A collaborative no-coding session where we work through building a real feature in Formalize: clarifying requirements, data modelling, and walking through pseudo-code together

• 
60-minute in-person interview to meet the team and a walkthrough of our career framework and offer details.

****About Formalize:

****Formalize is a tech company founded in 2021 with offices in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Milan, Madrid, and Munich. Currently, we are a team of +200 people from +30 nationalities operating in multiple European markets and are one of the fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups. We thrive on ambition, deliver impact through pragmatism, and embrace passion and honesty. We celebrate our wins, learn from our mistakes, and grow together as a team.

Our journey began in the whistleblowing compliance sector, highlighted by the award-winning Whistleblower Software by Formalize, which laid the foundation for our success story. Now, we have extended our expertise to a larger compliance universe, including data compliance, risk, and privacy.

Our Formalize product helps companies to effortlessly navigate and stay ahead in the ever-changing landscape of compliance. Our platform adapts to regulatory changes, continuously adapting to meet and foresee the evolving needs of our users, ensuring businesses remain compliant and confident in their operations.

Still curious? Read more about us here: About Formalize.

****Ready to apply?

****We interview on an ongoing basis and hire when the right person is found.

For more information or questions, please contact the listed recruiter at the bottom of the job page. Otherwise, apply with your resume and relevant information through our Career Page. We look forward to your application!

**Our Tech Stack: https://stackshare.io/companies/sedna

**About Sedna:

**Sedna is at the forefront of revolutionising the operating system for shipping. Our AI-powered platform is designed to make global trade more efficient, transparent, and sustainable. As we continue to grow and innovate, we are looking for exceptional talent to join our journey and contribute to our mission of transforming the shipping industry .

You can find out more about us on our website: https://sedna.com/

**About the role

**This role focuses on contributing to the design, development, and evolution of Sedna’s VMS (Voyage Management System). It's a mature, highly specialised platform that shipowners, operators and charterers use to run chartering, voyage operations, cargo and freight/hire invoicing.

VMS has a Java backend exposing a REST API used by our own web client (React) and directly by customers' integrations. Data lives in Oracle, including a significant amount of business logic in PL/SQL. It runs on AWS and builds through GitLab CI/CD.

Sedna VMS is in use 24/7 by shipping companies worldwide. Customers run their daily operations and invoicing on it, so correctness, performance and reliability directly affect their business.

You will play a key part in raising standards and delivering new features. You'll take real ownership of features and of how they behave in production, on a product customers run their business on, and help shape how the platform evolves. You'll work with modern AI-assisted development tools as part of everyday engineering.

**How you’ll make an impact

****Engineering and feature development

**This role contributes to both backend and frontend development. Day-to-day responsibilities include understanding requirements, shaping technical approaches, writing code, and contributing to automated tests. Development work spans a mix of new features, improvements, and maintenance, driven by both customer and product needs.

**System architecture and modernisation

**The role includes participating in ongoing efforts to refine and modernise the platform. This involves contributing to technical upgrade work, improving system structure, and supporting longer-term architectural direction as the product grows. Opportunities exist to participate in design discussions and help shape solutions that improve system performance, reliability, and extensibility.

**Quality, testing, and delivery practices

**The team maintains a focus on software quality. We combine unit tests, API regression tests (Postman) and UI tests (Playwright) with peer code review on every merge request. Releases are built and tested through GitLab CI/CD. We're actively improving here: getting more of our test suites running automatically in CI and making them reliable. Engineers who want to drive that, will have room to do it.

**Collaboration with product and customer-facing teams

**The role involves close collaboration with product managers through refinement, planning, and solution discussions. Engineers also interact with Customer Support on cases that need engineering input, and, for larger projects, join customer conversations to validate technical approaches.

**Continuous improvement and documentation

**We treat documentation, including API references, design decisions and runbooks, as part of delivering a change. Much of VMS's knowledge still sits with experienced team members, and capturing it in written, searchable form is an active priority. We also reserve time for technical debt and internal improvements.

**In your first 90 days, you can expect

**

• Month 1: Build your understanding of Sedna’s architecture and our products. Get set up with the VMS codebase, your dev environment and the release process, and ship your first changes. Meet your team, product manager and key customer-facing colleagues. Learn the maritime workflows our customers depend on.

• Month 2: Take ownership of a well-scoped piece of work from refinement with product through to release. Contribute to design discussions, give timely and constructive code review feedback. Shadow the on-call rotation and get familiar with runbooks and production tooling.

• Month 3: Lead the technical approach on a complex feature or improvement within your team, working independently and raising risks and dependencies early. Join the on-call rotation. Contribute improvements to tests, runbooks or documentation based on what you found hard to learn, and support technical validation in a customer conversation where relevant.

**What we're looking for:

****Essential experience

**Candidates typically bring three+ years of professional engineering experience from a comparable environment. Experience working on production systems where quality and reliability are important. Familiarity with a JVM language (Java, Kotlin, Scala) or a similar backend language, React or another modern frontend framework. Strong SQL and relational database skills, ideally Oracle or PostgreSQL, including query performance. Experience supporting production systems: diagnosing incidents from logs and metrics. Prior on-call experience is a plus.

**Critical skills

**A strong grasp of building and maintaining features within a larger system is helpful. Confidence with automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and code review workflows is expected. Clear thinking, good problem-solving ability, and the capacity to work with domain-heavy logic contribute to success in the role. Experience with enterprise or workflow-driven applications is an advantage.

**Traits and mindset

**Curiosity and a willingness to learn the maritime domain are appreciated. A collaborative working style, comfort sharing ideas in cross-functional settings, and the ability to work independently when needed all support strong performance. Adaptability is important as the product and architecture continue to evolve.

**Core competencies

**Systems thinking, ownership of outcomes, strong communication skills, and effective collaboration are central to this role. A motivation to create value for customers and contribute to a stable, evolving platform is essential.

**What’s In Store for You

**

• A strong team. You’ll join a global team of senior and staff engineers who set a high bar and will help level you up.

• A generous salary and benefits package (depending on experience) + private medical, equity, health and wellbeing benefits, home internet contribution

• Scalability challenges. You’ll be a part of evolving our VMS system as we further develop in to a product led company.

• Customer impact. Real customers use our products everyday, you'll see your work impacting real people.

• Collaboration & autonomy. Plenty of heads-down technical work, but also close partnership with product engineers and engineering leadership.

**Our Values:

**Finally, culture is important to us, so we also look for candidates who share our values:

**Stay Ahead, Stay Agile

**

• We don’t just adapt-we anticipate change and act with confidence.

• Curiosity, data, and customer insights help us stay ahead of the curve.

• We embrace challenges as opportunities and remain resilient under pressure.

• By staying open to new ideas and ways of working, we lead the future.

**Execute With Focus

**

• We turn strategy into action, delivering measurable results that matter.

• Every initiative counts-discipline and ownership drive business impact.

• We make smart decisions with speed, balancing pace and precision.

• Clear priorities keep us focused on what moves the needle.

**Work Together, Win Together

**

• Collaboration is our superpower-we succeed as one team, internally and with customers.

• We co-create solutions, seek feedback, and build the future of Sedna together.

• Strong relationships are built on trust, respect, and shared goals.

• By aligning across teams and with customers, we unlock greater impact.

About Portchain

Portchain exists to make maritime shipping more predictable, efficient, and green. We help shipping companies and terminals coordinate around shared, trustworthy information to reduce delays, fuel consumption, and emissions.

Our products support some of the world’s largest shipping companies, with more than 200 terminals connected through the Portchain Network.

The role

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer with deep backend experience in Node.js and TypeScript.

You’ll build services, APIs, and integrations that power carrier and terminal workflows, berth planning, and new products. Working closely with Product, you’ll turn customer problems into simple, scalable solutions and own your work from design through production.

Our stack includes Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and Google Cloud, with Terraform, GitHub Actions, and Datadog.

How we work

Product teams of four or more engineers, each supported by a dedicated Product Manager, but with overlap between teams when needed.

We care about craftsmanship: understandable code, trustworthy high quality data, thoughtful user experiences, and systems that remain reliable and maintainable. We balance that care with pragmatic decisions and still deploy 10+ per day.

Curiosity matters here. We ask questions, explore customer problems, challenge assumptions, and learn from each other and from mistakes without blame.

How we use AI

AI is a core part of our engineering workflow. We use it for exploration, implementation, review, and technical sparring, and share useful practices with the team. We move faster than any of our customers, but not at the expense of quality or engineering understanding of behavior.

The final judgment remains with the engineer. We expect you to understand, review, validate, and be able to defend the code and decisions you ship, while protecting customer and company data.

What we’re looking for

• Substantial experience building and operating production backend systems with Node.js and TypeScript, including asynchronous execution, error handling, and diagnosing production issues.

• Strong relational database skills: schema design, SQL, transactions, and query performance. We use PostgreSQL.

• Experience designing robust APIs and integrating systems with different data formats and reliability characteristics.

• Experience deploying and operating software on GCP, AWS, Azure, or a similar cloud platform. We use GCP (Cloud Run, Cloud SQL etc.)

• Sound architectural judgment, pride in your craft, and the ability to turn loosely defined problems into pragmatic solutions.

• Curiosity about unfamiliar domains and technologies, clear communication, and a collaborative approach to end-to-end ownership.

Useful extras include

GCP/Cloud Run, Terraform, CI/CD and observability, complex data ingestion, ISO 27001 or SOC 2 experience, and breadth across languages or technical side projects.

What we offer

• Meaningful work with global economic and environmental impact.

• Influence over products, architecture, and ways of working.

• Experienced, curious, and supportive colleagues.

• Competitive compensation and pension.

• Flexible working hours in our Copenhagen office.

• Subsidized lunch, snacks, and drinks.

• A dedicated development budget and support for continued learning.

If the role sounds exciting and you believe you can contribute, we would like to hear from you.

Would you like to join the Regulatory Report team in Reporting Solutions, responsible for several critical business solutions and reporting processes within Credit and Financial Risk? Do you want to participate in the data tech transformation in BEC, soon to be Nykredit Financial Technologies?

BEC is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Reporting Solutions domain. The position will be based at our friendly office in Roskilde or Warsaw.

Reporting Solutions plays a vital role in ensuring compliance of BEC’s member banks by managing a portfolio of 40+ business solutions within the business areas of Credit Risk and Finance Solutions, including several business-critical data hubs that support banks' business processes, internal reporting, and obligations in regulatory reporting.

You will join the Regulatory Reporting team with responsibility for both maintenance and development of a portfolio of business solutions that ensure accurate, reliable, and traceable data for our Credit Risk - Standardized Approach (SA-CR) provided by NASDAQ (Axiom), Unlikeliness to Pay, ESG and other applications within Regulatory Reporting.

You will join a high‑performing, cross‑functional team, combining solid business knowledge with strong software engineering practices. The team works with Mainframe, Netezza, and Databricks platforms and does coding in COBOL, Java, SQL, and Python, and apply BI tools such as PowerCenter. The team is currently situated in Herning but will transition and consolidate in Roskilde and Warsaw by end of 2027.

This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the forefront of BEC’s data tech transformation, using modern, Cloud-based technologies and event‑driven architectures to build scalable data products to substitute for current business solutions. This will give banks easier access to trusted, consistent data, whether for self-service analytics, reporting, regulatory requirements, or operational processes.

**Primary tasks and responsibilities include:

**

• Manage incidents and problems effectively in close collaboration with colleagues and clients

• Maintain and develop systems, data, and platforms within the business area of Credit Risk

• Ensure stable operations through maintenance, housekeeping, and quality improvements

• Design and maintain end-to-end data processing flows for our Credit Risk - Standardized Approach and other applications within the team

• Develop high-quality business solutions based on business requirements in close cooperation with key stakeholders internally in BEC and clients

• Collaborate closely with Business Analysts, Software Engineers, and Architects in Reporting Solutions to ensure high-quality, reliable, and well‑governed data foundations

• Contribute to continuous improvement of the development process and client engagement

**To succeed you will have:

**

• 5y+ work experience as Senior Software Engineer from Banking or financial IT

• Preferably, work experience from the banking sector in Denmark or banks under regulations from EBA

• Extensive experience in ETL tools (SQL, Python, and Java)

• Hands-on experience in writing and optimizing SQL

• Experience in gathering development requirements

• Knowledge of data modeling and data warehouse architecture

• Preferably, work experience with NASDAQs AXIOM Platform

• Strong collaboration and communication skills.

• Fluency in English, written and spoken.

**It’s nice-to-have:

**

• A relevant Master degree

• Experience in Git, Jira, and CI/CD pipelines

• Preferable experience with PowerCenter workflow development

• Experience of working in agile setups like Scrum or SAFe.

**Be your best self with BEC's benefits!

**We offer a diverse range of benefits for our employees. Here are just a few of them.

• Professional development budget

• Healthy, varied lunch and fruit in the canteen

• Active staff associations: yoga, cycling, go-karting, games, bowling etc.

• Pension scheme

• Health and dentist insurance

• Referral bonus

**What does the recruitment process look like?

**

• Send us your CV: We want to get to know you

• Screening call: Let's chat and see if we're a match

• Meet our technical expert and your future manager: Show off your experience

• Time to sign the contract: We're ready to welcome you to BEC!

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Talent Attraction Partner Anna.Barcinska@BEC.dk

BEC is in the process of being acquired by our largest customer and co-owner, Nykredit, which is Denmark's largest mortgage provider and third-largest bank. We will become part of a new and larger organization called Nykredit Financial Technologies. In the transition phase, we are recruiting for roles that we expect to be highly needed in our future organization.

What Makes Us, Us  Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**Our Accounting team is growing and we are looking for more team members to join. If you are curious, collaborative and enjoy taking initiative this could be a great place to work. You do not need to have all answers from day one. What matters to us is that you are open to learning, willing to try and comfortable to step into new challenges.

At SimCorp, we support some of the largest financial institutions in the world to be successful by simplifying their investments, accounting and operations.

Accounting is a unit within SimCorp’s Product Division which delivers all rules and calculation methods in order to provide our clients with a legally binding subledger for all supported asset classes.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**

• Develop and maintain features in the Accounting product areas.

• Contribute across the entire development lifecycle - from requirements analysis and design to implementation, test automation, documentation, and ongoing support.

• Collaborate closely with teammates, Product Managers, and Architects to deliver high-quality and secure solutions.

• Create, document and maintain test cases and automated tests to cover the features’ acceptance criteria (system, integration, unit etc.)

• Uphold engineering best practices and contribute to continuous improvement.

• Learn deeply about our Accounting domain and understand how our products support customer outcomes.

• Be open to feedback, mentorship, and knowledge sharing in your team.

**Your Skills

**Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed for doing that is less important. We expect you to be good at several of the following and be able to - and interested in - learn the rest.

• Confident in software engineering fundamentals, including algorithms and data structures.

• Willingness to learn and work with in-house tools and frameworks, especially the APL programming language.

• Proficiency in at least one object-oriented or functional programming language (C# is a benefit).

• Familiarity with modern engineering tools and practices, including CI/CD and trunk-based development.

• Experience working with relational databases and SQL.

• Readiness to work in a complex accounting domain, dealing with financial and investment-related instruments.

• Good English skills (upper-intermediate or higher), both written and spoken.

• Experience with cloud technologies and fintech domain is a plus.

**What Is It Like To Work Here

**SimCorp plans work in an agile manner, using 4 planning intervals (PI’s) per year, each consisting of 5 sprints of 2 weeks each, followed by a 3-week Innovation and Planning sprint, which can be used for mastering skills in various areas, or more freely investigating ideas with prototypes. It is important that our people learn and grow constantly, and SimCorp invests a lot to foster the continuous learning environment to support people on their journeys.

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

**Benefits

**An attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential components of any employment package. At SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. In addition to the traditional benefits, we promote an effective work-life balance, including flexible work hours and a hybrid workplace model. As a large organization, we offer a wide range of career opportunities, with an individualized approach to professional development to support the career path you wish to pursue.

**NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible. We process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed.** At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

**WHO WE ARE?

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

Are you interested in sustainability, enjoy working with data, and want to turn reporting requirements into practical action? Join Flatpay and help build the foundations of our ESG work across multiple markets!

We’re looking for a curious, structured colleague who enjoys digging into details, connecting with people, and bringing order to complex information.

**About Flatpay

**Flatpay is not just another payment solution; we're dedicated to innovating the market for payment solutions and financial services in the SME segment with our customer-centric and transparent services.

We've grown into one of the fastest-growing fintech companies out of the Nordics and Denmark's fastest unicorn company. Today, we're more than 2,500 colleagues across Europe, building products that make a real difference for our customers.

We're ambitious, move fast, and like to challenge the status quo - but we also believe work should be fun. We celebrate wins, help each other out, and create an environment where people can do great work while genuinely enjoying the journey.

**What You'll Do

**You’ll coordinate ESG data collection and reporting across our markets, working with internal teams, suppliers, and external compliance partners. From reviewing supplier documentation to improving reporting processes, you’ll help ensure we have reliable information and clear ways of working as we grow.

This is a hands-on role with international exposure and room to develop. You’ll help shape Flatpay’s ESG function from the ground up, taking increasing ownership as your knowledge and experience grow.

• Coordinate ESG reporting across markets. Organize data collection, follow up on inputs, and support accurate, timely reporting, including CSRD-related work where applicable.

• Build a reliable data foundation. Review compliance reports, product documentation, and supplier data sheets; identify gaps; and source the information needed for reporting.

• Work across teams and borders. Collaborate with colleagues, suppliers, and external compliance partners to make reporting processes clear and manageable.

• Track relevant requirements. Help assess what developments in CSRD, the Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR), and local producer responsibility schemes mean for Flatpay.

• Coordinate producer responsibility reporting. Work with Dansk Producentansvar (DPA), equivalent organisations in other markets, and relevant compliance partners.

• Support practical sustainability initiatives. Contribute to improvements in reverse logistics, refurbishment, and how we manage products throughout their lifecycle.

• Help establish our ESG function. Build processes, improve data quality, and gradually become an internal point of contact for sustainability reporting and compliance questions.

**Who You Are

**

• An interest in ESG and sustainability, particularly the data and reporting behind them.

• An analytical mindset and confidence working with spreadsheets and structured data.

• A careful, organised approach: you spot inconsistencies, ask questions, and follow through.

• The ability to work with colleagues and suppliers to get the information you need.

• Curiosity about regulations and the ability to translate complex information into clear next steps.

• Strong communication skills in English and an interest in working across international markets.

Previous exposure to ESG reporting, sustainability, compliance, or data analysis is a plus. This could come from a full-time role, student position or involvement in relevant project. Familiarity with CSRD or producer responsibility is welcome, but you don’t need to arrive as an expert in every framework.

**Why Flatpay

**Joining Flatpay means stepping into a dynamic environment where innovation is encouraged, and teamwork is celebrated. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact, contributing to our mission of empowering merchants to succeed.

In this role, you'll have the opportunity to build practical ESG experience across multiple markets and see the direct impact of your work. Your ideas will help shape our processes, strengthen our reporting, and inform how we approach sustainability as we scale.

With us, you’ll experience an ambitious drive to constantly push boundaries and redefine what's possible. While we don’t take ourselves too seriously, we take our responsibility towards our people very seriously. We welcome driven, low-ego individuals who live our values and want to grow with us.

Established in 2022 in Copenhagen with a commitment to transparency, we've streamlined card payments to small and medium-sized businesses. Our innovative pricing model eliminates hidden costs and fees, offering a simple flat rate for all cards with no monthly subscription for our point-of-sale and payment solutions.

Operating in Denmark, Finland, Germany, Italy, France, the United Kingdom, and the Netherlands, we're more than just a service provider; we are your trusted business partner.

We continuously strive to stay ahead of the curve, adapting our solutions to meet our clients' evolving needs. Ready to be part of something extraordinary?

Iryna Gomon

WHAT MAKES US, US

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered. If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

Portfolio Analysis is where investment professionals turn data into insight on portfolios, performance and risk. Our products are business critical and widely used, so they need to keep evolving in a responsible way. Right now that means strong maintainability, high system performance, mature CI/CD, and reshaping parts of SimCorp Dimension for the cloud.

As a Senior Software Engineer in our Product Division, you will join an agile team of 5–7 people in the Portfolio Analysis Product Area. You will mainly work on backend components, APIs and services, using C#, .NET, Dyalog APL and Oracle.

AI is part of how we work every day. We see it as a natural part of modern software engineering, alongside source control, testing, CI/CD and code reviews. AI does not replace engineering judgment. It helps good engineers learn faster, reduce repetitive work and build better software.

WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

• Understand and challenge customer requirements together with your team, then design, implement, test and support the chosen solutions

• Design, develop and maintain backend functionality and APIs using C# and .NET, and work with Dyalog APL where it is part of the product

• Contribute to cloud modernization and scalable service design where it adds real value

• Improve performance, maintainability, testability and developer experience

• Take ownership beyond code: contribute to design discussions and help the team make sound technical decisions

• Use CI/CD, automated testing and code reviews as natural parts of daily engineering work

• Use AI every day in practical engineering work, such as exploring ideas, understanding unfamiliar code, prototyping, improving tests, documenting decisions and automating routine tasks

• Help the team discover where AI creates real value and where traditional engineering judgment should lead

• Collaborate with product owners, domain experts and fellow engineers to turn customer needs into good software

WHAT WE VALUE

How you gained your skills matters less than your ability to learn, collaborate and take ownership. We expect you to know some of the following and to be interested in learning the rest:

• C# and .NET development, backend development and API design

• Building high-performance, scalable and maintainable applications

• Continuous integration and delivery, automated testing and practical quality engineering

**Why Faculty?

**We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

**Why the Faculty Fellowship?

**Founded in 2014, Faculty is one of Europe’s leading applied AI companies. Faculty’s PhD-heavy team of deep AI experts has delivered hundreds of real-world AI products to improve critical public services and drive sustained economic returns across every sector of the economy. Widely recognised as a leader in AI safety, Faculty works for the world’s leading AI labs, such as OpenAI, Meta and Anthropic, to ensure their latest models are safe, human-led and explainable.

The Faculty Fellowship builds the AI talent engine for the world’s most ambitious organisations. It selects exceptional scientific minds and accelerates them into the top tier of AI practitioners. Past Fellows hold some of the most critical AI posts for organisations across every sector of the economy.

As part of our international expansion, we are bringing the Faculty Fellowship to Denmark through Halfspace (part of Faculty), a leading applied AI company in Copenhagen. Building on Faculty’s decade-long track record of developing exceptional AI talent and Halfspace’s expertise in delivering real-world AI solutions, the Fellowship will offer outstanding STEM talent in Denmark an opportunity to accelerate their careers in AI. As a Fellow, you will learn directly from leading AI practitioners before being embedded within an ambitious organisation, applying advanced AI and data science to solve complex commercial challenges and deliver meaningful impact.

**How It Works

**

• 2 Weeks of Intensive Training: Learn to apply your advanced technical knowledge to real-world data science problems.

• 6 Week Paid Placement: Tackle a commercial data science project with a host company.

• Demo Day Finale: Present your work to senior stakeholders and industry leaders, showcasing your technical capabilities and project impact.

Where our alumni go: our alumni have gone on to shape the future at companies like Google, Meta, Tesco and AstraZeneca, as well as disruptive startups like Physics X and Orbital Witness. We are also incredibly proud that a high percentage of fellows choose to continue their journey internally, joining the Faculty team permanently.

**About The Role

**As a Fellow at Faculty, you will join an elite cohort transforming industries through cutting-edge data science. This intensive, eight week programme bridges academic and real world impact, embedding you directly into highs-stakes commercial environments. You will apply advanced machine learning techniques to solve complex, ambiguous problems for our clients, turning theoretical knowledge into high-value deployable solutions. It is a fast-paced launchpad designed to accelerate your technical growth, build exceptional commercial acumen and employer you to shape the future of artificial intelligence in an ambitious, forward-thinking tech community.

**Who We're Looking For

**

• You hold a finished PhD or Master’s degree in a STEM subject, complemented by a strong foundation in data science or machine learning.

• You possess a high level of mathematical competence alongside solid experience with theoretical concepts like hypothesis testing, Bayesian inference, and neural networks.

• You demonstrate strong programming skills, particularly in Python, and feel comfortable navigating core data science coding libraries.

• You bring an entrepreneurial mindset, showing the resilience and autonomy needed to structure your own project plans and hit critical deadlines.

• You can communicate complex technical ideas clearly, adapting your language seamlessly for both technical peers and non-technical partners.

• You thrive in fast-paced, ambitious environments, showing curiosity and a relentless drive to learn and deploy new technologies.

**Requirements

**

• Right to work: We’re unfortunately unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role, so you’ll need to already have the right to work in Denmark. This includes citizens of EU/EEA countries and Switzerland, as well as anyone holding a valid Danish work permit or residence status. If your eligibility is based on a visa or permit, please include the details in your application so we can review your situation.

• Location & Logistics: This is a fully in-person, eight-week programme based in Copenhagen, Denmark so you will need to be able to commute daily for the entire duration. Please keep in mind that Faculty is unable to provide or reimburse accommodation and travel expenses.

**Our Timelines

**

• December 2026: Coding tests sent via email.

• January 2026: Interviewing starts - held remotely online.

• February 2027: Final notifications sent to all applicants.

• March 2027*: Programme starts.

• Please note that programme dates are tentative and may be adjusted if required. We will notify all applicants of any updates and changes as early as possible.

What the Fellowship offers

• Paid Experience: Fellows receive a competitive stipend/salary for the full eight-week duration of the programme.

• Expert-Led Training: Two weeks of immersive lectures followed by weekly Friday masterclasses, bridging the gap between academic theory and commercial data science.Dedicated Mentorship: Receive ongoing support and guidance from experienced Faculty practitioners, gaining insight into how AI and data science are applied to solve real-world business challenges while developing your technical, commercial and communication skills.

• Real-World Value: A dedicated six-week placement embedded with a business, tackling a high-stakes data science challenge.

• Career Launchpad: A proven pathway into industry, backed by a decade-long track record of launching exceptional individuals into top-tier AI careers.

• Unrivalled Networking: Connect with a 500+ strong alumni community and pitch your project to 100+ industry guests at Demo Day.

**Our Recruitment Ethos

**We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

Gubra is a science-enabled biotech company advancing peptide-based drug discovery, development and preclinical research, driven by impact for patients, planet and people.
